# Evolutions in Red Rogue

Many evolutions here work differently from the main games. This guide lists every one.

## How evolution works

- **Trade evolutions also happen by level-up.** A Pokémon that evolves by trade in the main games evolves at the level listed, or instantly in a real trade at any level.
- **Evolution stones work at any level.**
- **The Mist Stone** evolves any Pokémon with an evolution into a branch you choose. On an Eevee it rolls one of the branches your run has unlocked, at random.
- **Species groups gate evolutions.** An evolution into a Johto or Time Warp species or form only happens while that group is unlocked and enabled for your run. Forms that already carry their own form forward (an Alolan Rattata growing into Alolan Raticate) are never blocked.
- **Fusions and some special forms never evolve.**
- **The Pokédex shows what is possible right now.** Open an owned Pokémon's entry and press A through to the last page: it lists only the evolutions your current run allows.

Markers in the tables: ★ is listed under Highlights, ⇄ is a trade evolution that also works by level-up. Form prefixes: A- Alolan, G- Galarian, H- Hisuian, P- Paldean.

Second branches and regional forms that a stone makes, plus Honchkrow and Ursaluna, which Red Rogue stores as forms of Murkrow and Ursaring.

### Eevee's eight stones
